jcr_content.jcr:title: Starterkit SKIT100-E41S
jcr_content.jcr:description: The combination of the MB-SMARC-100100-1 carrier board and the TQMxE41S computer-on-module is ideal for evaluating Intel Atom x7000E/RE-based embedded solutions. The modular approach with SMARC 2.1 standard enables a quick start from the test system to the individual solution. The focus here is on two network interfaces as well as USB 3.2/2.0 and DisplayPort. The interfaces are arranged in such a way that, for example, flat mounting on DIN rail is possible. Three M.2 slots for SSDs and wireless communication cards are available on the bottom side. Proof-of-concepts, for example in the IoT and Industry 4.0 sector, can be implemented quickly and easily. RS-485 is available for connecting sensors. Individual IO/sensor expansion cards can be added via the expansion connector on the side, which customers can design themselves quickly and easily.
jcr_content.keywords: FPGA, Power-Efficient Architecture, High-Speed I/O, Digital Signal Processing, Reliability, Scalability, Custom

textwithimage.text:
Evaluation Kit with SMARC module TQMxE41S (Intel Atom x7000 series, "Alder Lake-N" & "Amston Lake")

Evaluation for easy and fast system integration based on the Embedded Module TQMT1042 and the next generation of the well-known QorIQ® product family TQMP1020/2020.

text.text:
Features

  • MB-SMARC-100100-1 (Type B) + TQMxE41S
  • For evaluation with Intel Atom x7000E / x7000RE Processor Series, as well as Intel Processor N Series and Intel Core i3-N305 Processor
  • Pre-assembled and ready-to-use incl. cooling
  • Ultra compact at just 100 mm x 100 mm
  • Slim design with direct connection of the module interfaces
  • Expandable via several M.2 slots
  • Ideally suited for proof-of-concepts in the IoT and robotic sectors
  • Connector arrangement suitable for flat DIN rail mounting

TQ Embedded is known for:

  • Precision German engineering, now with a North America presence
    • Robust industrial products with support
  • Widest portfolio of embedded processing architectures: ARM, x86, PowerPC 
  • Comprehensive in-house process and facilities for true long-life availability
  • Modules with full signal availability (ALL signals available, not just selective groups)
  • In-house full control: design, manufacturing, specialized adaptations
  • Robust baseboard options, production-ready for mounting their SOM products
